question: I would like to know the given names of baseball players who have achieved the highest value of games played, runs, hits, and home runs, with their corresponding score values.
sql: SELECT p.name_given, TRY_CAST(SUM(TRY_CAST(b.g AS DOUBLE)) AS DOUBLE) as games_played, TRY_CAST(SUM(TRY_CAST(b.r AS DOUBLE)) AS DOUBLE) as runs, TRY_CAST(SUM(TRY_CAST(b.h AS DOUBLE)) AS DOUBLE) as hits, TRY_CAST(SUM(TRY_CAST(b.hr AS DOUBLE)) AS DOUBLE) as home_runs, TRY_CAST(SUM(TRY_CAST(b.g AS DOUBLE)) + SUM(TRY_CAST(b.r AS DOUBLE)) + SUM(TRY_CAST(b.h AS DOUBLE)) + SUM(TRY_CAST(b.hr AS DOUBLE)) AS DOUBLE) as total_score FROM batting b JOIN player p ON b.player_id = p.player_id WHERE TRY_CAST(b.g AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST(b.r AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST(b.h AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST(b.hr AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.player_id, p.name_given ORDER BY total_score DESC LIMIT 1
